subject: website
name: Stuck Funds Checker
summary: A checker for unclaimed onchain funds. No public source was found. It is Level 2: when the page opens it loads the Cloudflare Turnstile script from challenges.cloudflare.com with no integrity hash, and it asks the project's own API (a Railway server) for statistics; lookups also go to that server.
